statement: The sketch visualizes a city-block scale metabolic landscape through layered rhythmic animations. A deep indigo field serves as the backdrop for pulsing white medical waveforms whose colors shift along a cyan-purple spectrum synchronized with the underlying rhythm. Oxidized copper wire lattice structures form geometric lace patterns that contract and expand with metabolic cycles. Hundreds of semi-transparent mineral crystal particles drift through this space with organic waltzing motion, occasionally forming brief connections when they align within proximity ranges. The entire composition breathes in unison through a shared temporal parameter, creating an interconnected biological-metabolic ecosystem.
